{{Top|leg}}
A '''Relephonian sarsestone''' was a type of stone presumably from the [[Relephon Moons|moons]] of [[Relephon]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> 

In [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] tried using a Relephonian sarsestone in scrubbing away her [[Darth Caedus|brother's]] [[Blood trail|blood]] off her neck and failed.<ref name="invincible" />
